content.text:
Three laptops have batteries approaching end-of-life: a MacBook Pro (7VP16KHV88LM), a ThinkPad X1 Carbon (8NM23J95R5I6) and a Dell XPS 15 (M4XVHUV1MEPZ). Each one meets all three warning signs, and all are rated high severity [battery_eol/7VP16KHV88LM, battery_eol/8NM23J95R5I6, battery_eol/M4XVHUV1MEPZ].

**Evidence**
- **ThinkPad X1 Carbon, 8NM23J95R5I6 (emp-acme-1005):**
  - It has 1157 charge cycles, which is 116% of the 1000-cycle rating [battery_eol/8NM23J95R5I6].
  - It has reported "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-23 [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-05-23].
  - Its full-charge capacity fell 4.2%, from 4043 to 3872 mAh [8NM23J95R5I6/2026-05-14, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12].
- **MacBook Pro, 7VP16KHV88LM (emp-acme-1000):**
  - It has 1049 cycles, which is 105% of the rating [battery_eol/7VP16KHV88LM].
  - It has reported "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-30 [7VP16KHV88LM/2026-05-30].
  - Its capacity fell 4.2%, from 4348 to 4166 mAh [7VP16KHV88LM/2026-05-14, 7VP16KHV88LM/2026-06-12].
- **Dell XPS 15, M4XVHUV1MEPZ (emp-acme-1002):**
  - It has 948 cycles, which is 95% of the rating. That is past the "approaching" point but not yet over the rating [battery_eol/M4XVHUV1MEPZ].
  - It has reported "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-24 [M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-05-24].
  - Its capacity fell 4.2%, from 3406 to 3262 mAh [M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-05-14, M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-06-12].

**Caveats**
- **How "approaching end-of-life" is defined:** the policy rates batteries for 1000 cycles (`battery_rated_cycles`). A battery counts as approaching end-of-life once its cycle count passes a share of 0.9 of that rating (`battery_approaching_share`). It also counts if its full-charge capacity drops more than 3.0% over the 30-day window (`battery_fcc_decline_pct`). A "Service Recommended" status is also a warning sign.
- **Devices missed:** the check only looks at devices that report battery data. Laptops with missing battery data are a data collection gap, not proof of a healthy battery. I didn't look for such gaps separately.
- **Next steps:** I haven't proposed any actions. Battery service or replacement for these three devices would be the next step if you want it.
